versions.changelog: v1.0.0: Cover/thumbnail design skill for Bilibili, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and more. Features: title strategy system (10 types with emotion-gesture mapping), platform-specific rules, reference image analysis (16-dimension), portrait consistency system (identity locking + 10-pose library), no-text background prompt generation (universal/Midjourney/SD), layout specifications (fonts/colors/typography), quality scoring (10-dim, 100pt), optimization decision tree (7 problem types), batch production, account visual asset system. Scripts: batch_cover_brief.py (CSV to brief), prompt_pack_builder.py (brief to multi-tool prompts). All stdlib, zero dependencies.
